title: Villagers detain the police who came to detain
situation: At 6 am police come to a village to stop a local representative going to the Delhi protest. He makes calls; ~500 villagers gather and declare the police "under detention" until a senior officer explains. They release the police at 1 pm after getting a written note.

who.protester: Zila Parishad member and his village

lines.text: It was our duty to stop people from gathering in Delhi because the protest is illegal.
lines.speaker: SHO Rakesh Kumar

lines.text: the villagers are free to shoot videos and post them on social media.
lines.speaker: SHO Rakesh Kumar

lines.text: The written note mattered because the police "would have later denied having ever detained him."
lines.speaker: Jai Dev Dagar

reactionBeats: Seven-hour standoff; SHO says villagers treated police well throughout.

paraphrased: ThePrint live blog calls it a reversal moment.

buildThis.situation: Two constables come to pick up Mira early; Asha and the stall-holders surround them with chai and refuse to let them go without "likhit mein" (a written reason).
